description: This PHP script processes form submissions for saving a record in a CRM module. It handles assigning users or groups, updating object values from request data, and redirects to a detail or list view after saving.

classes.name: $focus
classes.description: An instance of the current module's class, used to perform save operations and hold record data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current record data to the database for the specified module.
